svg.title: How Subspace fits together
svg.desc: Your team works in the Subspace desktop app, sharing IRC channels, an issue tracker, decisions and the Fleet Console with fleets of coding agents. Each fleet is one VM run by Stargate, with a rear admiral, captains and their crews. Stakeholders reach the same agents from Slack or Microsoft Teams. Subspace and the fleets sit inside a private network, and the agents' work reaches GitHub as pull requests.
